description: Leiner Pak Gelatine Limited is a Pakistani gelatine manufacturer with roots dating to 1983, when it began as a collaboration with P. Leiner & Sons of Great Britain. It describes itself as the pioneer producer of halal gelatine in the Muslim world, making gelatine from a 100% halal bovine source with full traceability, at an annual capacity of 2,000 tonnes. It supplies customers in more than ten countries across Europe, Africa, Asia and the ASEAN region.
